title: Donruss #530 Jeff Peterek Milwaukee Brewers Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1990 Donruss Jeff Peterek Rookie trading card featuring the player from the Milwaukee Brewers team. This vintage baseball card, measuring 3½" x 2½", is an original card from the Donruss set. As a part of the Sports Trading Card type, this collectible item is a must-have for fans of Jeff Peterek and the Milwaukee Brewers from the 1990 season.
